Subject: Intro: Candidate Priya Rao — scheduling full loop

Hi team,

Quick intro — Priya Rao is the candidate we discussed for the Senior Backend role. Resume attached. She’s based in the Bay Area and is available Weds/Thurs next week in the afternoon PT.

Can we lock a hybrid (Zoom + optional on-site) full-loop for ~4 hours with the following intent:
- 45m system design
- 60m coding exercise (pair + take-home review)
- 30m product/PM cross-functional touch
- 30m culture/leadership & manager interview
- 15m buffer + 30m debrief with interviewers (async OK if needed)

My ask: please propose a concrete slot and confirm interviewers. Priya prefers morning/early afternoon PT but can shift.

Thanks,
Alexandra Cole (TalentFinder)
Recruiter — Tech Placements
Attachments: Priya_Rao_Resume.pdf

Thanks Alexandra — looping in hiring manager (Laura) and debrief owner (Marissa) to confirm. Priya — great to e-meet you, copying the full loop below as a proposed agenda.

Proposed hybrid full-loop (Weds 12/06, tentative):
- 10:00–10:45 PT: System design (Zoom) — Karthik Iyer (backend architect)
- 11:00–12:00 PT: Pair coding (candidate + Karthik) — live coding on CoderPad; exercise will be followed by 20m synchronous readout
- 12:00–12:30 PT: Product cross-functional (Zoom) — Laura Bennett (Hiring Manager)
- 12:30–12:45 PT: Break / buffer
- 12:45–13:15 PT: Leadership & culture (Zoom or onsite) — Marissa Cole (Director, Eng Ops)
- 13:15–13:45 PT: Interviewer debrief (internal-only) — Marissa to run, notes in runbook (async write-up allowed within 2 hours)

Logistics/asks:
- If anyone needs a different slot, say so by EOD Mon 12/04.
- Karthik: can you own the coding exercise and confirm whether you want 60m or 50m + 10m readout?
- Marissa: you’re the debrief owner — I’ll create the shared doc and calendar invite, please add any evaluation rubrics.
- Priya: would you prefer remote-only or the option to come on-site for the latter half (if feasible)?

I attached a small runbook template for the debrief and interviewer checklist. I’ll send calendar invites after folks confirm.

Thanks — Sergio
Sergio Alvarez

sergio.alvarez@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Sergio — I can do the design + coding but prefer this tweak: make the coding slot 50m with a 25m readout rather than 60m straight. My concern is candidate fatigue in a continuous 60m session; a short break after the design slot helps. If we move product to 12:15–12:40 and leadership to 12:45–13:15, we can keep the debrief at 13:15.

Confirming I’ll own the coding exercise and will prepare a starter prompt; will share CoderPad link once invite is out.
